records.question: Which team won the most games in 2001? Give the team name and wins.

records.question: How many players were born in Japan?

records.question: What was the highest salary last season?
Which franchise has the most all-time wins? Give the franchise ID and total wins.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT t.franchID, SUM(t.W) AS total_wins
FROM Teams t
GROUP BY t.franchID
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: What was the total home attendance of the Boston Red Sox in 2019?
How many home runs did Mark McGwire hit in 1997?
Who hit the most home runs in 1997? Give first name, last name and home runs.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, b.HR
FROM Batting b
JOIN People p ON b.playerID = p.playerID
WHERE b.yearID = 1997
ORDER BY b.HR DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: For each player named Chris Young, give the playerID and career home runs.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT p.playerID, SUM(b.HR) AS career_home_runs
FROM People p
JOIN Batting b ON p.playerID = b.playerID
WHERE p.nameFirst = 'Chris' AND p.nameLast = 'Young'
GROUP BY p.playerID;

records.question: Which franchise has hit the most home runs all-time? Give the franchise name and total home runs.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT tf.franchName, SUM(b.HR) AS total_home_runs
FROM TeamsFranchises tf
JOIN Teams t ON tf.franchID = t.franchID
JOIN Batting b ON t.teamID = b.teamID AND t.yearID = b.yearID
GROUP BY tf.franchID
ORDER BY total_home_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: Who led MLB in home runs last season? Give first name, last name and home runs.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, b.HR
FROM Batting b
JOIN People p ON b.playerID = p.playerID
WHERE b.yearID = (SELECT MAX(yearID) FROM Batting)
ORDER BY b.HR DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: Which team had the highest total payroll in 2016? Give the team name and payroll.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT t.name, SUM(s.salary) AS total_payroll
FROM Salaries s
JOIN Teams t ON s.teamID = t.teamID AND s.yearID = t.yearID
WHERE s.yearID = 2016
GROUP BY t.name
ORDER BY total_payroll DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: List the first and last names of players who hit 40 or more home runs in 2001 and were All-Stars that year.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast
FROM Batting b
JOIN People p ON b.playerID = p.playerID
JOIN AllstarFull a ON b.playerID = a.playerID AND b.yearID = a.yearID
WHERE b.yearID = 2001 AND b.HR >= 40;

records.question: How many different players have played for the Los Angeles Dodgers franchise, including its Brooklyn years?
records.pred_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT playerID) AS num_players
FROM Appearances
WHERE teamID IN (
    SELECT teamID
    FROM Teams
    WHERE franchID = 'LAD'
);

records.question: Who was the highest-paid New York Yankees player in the most recent season with salary data? Give first name, last name and salary.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, s.salary
FROM Salaries s
JOIN People p ON s.playerID = p.playerID

AND s.teamID = 'NYA'

records.question: Which Hall of Fame inducted player has the most career home runs? Give first name, last name and home runs.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, SUM(b.HR) AS careerHR
FROM HallOfFame h
JOIN Batting b ON h.playerID = b.playerID
JOIN People p ON h.playerID = p.playerID
WHERE h.inducted = 'Y'
GROUP BY p.playerID
ORDER BY careerHR DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: List the first and last names of players who attended the University of Southern California and hit at least 100 career home runs, with their career home runs.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, SUM(b.HR) AS careerHR
FROM People p
JOIN CollegePlaying cp ON p.playerID = cp.playerID
JOIN Schools s ON cp.schoolID = s.schoolID
JOIN Batting b ON p.playerID = b.playerID
WHERE s.name_full = 'University of Southern California'
GROUP BY p.playerID
HAVING SUM(b.HR) >= 100;

records.question: For the 2001 Seattle Mariners, list each player's first name, last name, home runs for Seattle and salary, for the top 5 salaries.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, b.HR, s.salary
FROM Salaries s
JOIN People p ON s.playerID = p.playerID
JOIN Batting b ON s.playerID = b.playerID AND s.yearID = b.yearID AND s.teamID = b.teamID
WHERE s.yearID = 2001 AND s.teamID = 'SEA'
ORDER BY s.salary DESC
LIMIT 5;

records.question: How many pitches did Clayton Kershaw throw in his last start?
records.pred_sql:
SELECT p.BFP * 3 AS pitches_thrown
FROM Pitching p
JOIN (
    SELECT playerID, MAX(yearID) AS last_year
    FROM Pitching
    WHERE playerID = 'kershcl01'
    GROUP BY playerID
) last_start ON p.playerID = last_start.playerID AND p.yearID = last_start.last_year
WHERE p.playerID = 'kershcl01'
ORDER BY p.GS DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: What was Aaron Judge's batting average with runners in scoring position in 2025?
records.pred_sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(H) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(AB), 0), 3) AS batting_average_risp
FROM 
    Batting
WHERE 
    playerID = 'judgeaa01' 
    AND yearID = 2025 
    AND (RBI > 0 OR (H > 0 AND RBI = 0));
